newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-KEEGAN QUIT OVER SIGNORI DEAL, PAPER CLAIMS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-KEEGAN QUIT OVER SIGNORI DEAL, PAPER CLAIMS.

text.p: Kevin Keegan resigned as manager of Newcastle because the club blocked his move to sign striker Guiseppe Signori from Italy's Lazio, a local newspaper claimed on Thursday.
The Journal, a Newcastle-based paper, said Keegan mooted a bid for Signori before Christmas after his two regular strikers, Alan Shearer and Les Ferdinand, had both been injured.
It quoted a source as saying: "Kevin Keegan had lined up Signori but couldn't go through with the deal. He was told the funds weren't there unless players were sold."
If Keegan had signed Signori, top-scorer in serie A last season with 24 goals, it would have taken his spending at St James's Park to around 68 million pounds ($115 million) in five years.
The Journal said club chairman John Hall viewed a move for the Italian as one big-name bid too far.
